declare

 :Global.Error_count:='Y';

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_TIME_LIMIT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_time_limit is
 dummy1 VARCHAR2(1);
 interdiction_required boolean;
 temp_time number;
 
 v_gmt_time date;
 l_gmt_time date;
begin
 begin
--message('s_bleed_start_time is : '|| :s_bleed_start_time);pause;
--message('global.process_dats is : '|| to_char(to_date(:global.process_dats), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI') );pause;

/*
 if :process_dats is not null then

 --MS Converting Local time to GMT.
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :process_dats, v_gmt_time); 
 :PROCESS_DATS_DUM := v_gmt_time;
 else
 l_gmt_time := :process_dats;
 end if;
 --
 end if;
*/
--message('GMT time is : '|| :PROCESS_DATS_DUM );pause;
 
 select a.time_limit into temp_time
 from chapters b, valid_products a
 where b.chapter_id = :chapter_id and
 a.product_code = substr(:product_code,1,5) and
 --MS ((:process_dats - :s_bleed_start_time) +
 --
 ((:PROCESS_DATS_DUM - :s_bleed_start_time ) +
 (b.ffp_freeze_durn/24)) > (a.time_limit/24);
--message('After select statement :' || temp_time);pause;

 interdiction_required := TRUE;
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then 
 interdiction_required := FALSE;
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 begin
 select 'x' into dummy1 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and 
 chapter_id = :chapter_id and
 product_code = :product_code and
 inter_code = 'CMTI';
 if interdiction_required then
 null;
 else
 show_error('0384');
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 if interdiction_required then
 gen_cmti_interdiction;
 end if;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GEN_CMTI_INTERDICTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure gen_cmti_interdiction is
 temp_return_val varchar2(30);
begin
 message('Msg:Component has CMTI interdiction.');
 temp_return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 :unit_id,
 :coll_date ,
 :chapter_id,
 :product_code,
 'CMTI',
 :banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if temp_return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdiction CMTI not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
exception when others then
 handle_error;
end;
